working_definition: Cluster 'Tm9' (GEO label, adult Davie 2018 optic lobe data) annotated by the authors as the single type Tm9. Mapped at face value to the FBbt term for the named type; cluster is composed primarily of cells of this type.
searches_performed: local FBbt (fbbt-full.obo) lookup by label/synonym (OLS MCP returned 503)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that has most of its dendritic arborization in medulla layers M2 and M3, with some extensions into M1, M4 and M5 (Gao et al., 2008; Ting et al., 2014), and presynapses in M3 (Gao et al., 2008). Its axon follows the posterior edge of its cognate medulla column (Ting et al., 2014), then crosses in the second optic chiasma and terminates in lobula layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Ting et al., 2014), where it outputs to T5 neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2014). It is a cholinergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008; Shinomiya et al., 2014). It expresses the transcription factor sim (Ozel et al., 2021). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: The authors' GEO label names the single type Tm9; FBbt has a non-obsolete adult term for it (transmedullary neuron Tm9, FBbt:00003797). Taken at face value under the 'composed primarily of' relation.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the dorsal half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt10 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors name a single Tm9 type (no a/b split); mapped to the parent Tm9 term.
